c74object.name: j.view
c74object.digest: Declare patcher as the view of a model
c74object.description: j.view declares a patcher as the view of a model. It binds to the model named by its argument, or else to the model of the same class (qmetro.model for qmetro.view) in the patcher that contains the view, and follows it when the model comes or goes. A message parameter value sets that parameter of the model.

objarg.name: model
objarg.description: An absolute address, or one relative to the model of the patcher that contains the view.

method.name: anything
method.digest: Send a value to a parameter of the model
method.description: The message parameter value sends the value to the parameter of the model the view is bound to, and repeats the message out the left outlet. While the view has no model nothing is sent and the console says so. The left outlet also reports name value for every change seen by a j.remote of the view that has a name (its second argument) and a relative address, and for every parameter and return placed in the view patcher.

method.name: dump
method.description: The dump message answers model:address and the address of the model while the view is bound, or model:waiting while it is not, out the rightmost outlet.

method.name: model:address
method.description: model:address followed by an address binds the view to that model (an absolute address, or one relative to the model of the containing patcher); the objects of the view that follow its model, such as j.ui and j.remote, bind again. While there is no model at the address the view waits for it. Without an address the message answers like dump.

attribute.description: Accepted so that old patchers load; it has no effect yet.

attribute.name: description
attribute.description: A textual description of the view for auto-documentation purposes.
